r.name: PCIR1 Ticino
r.description: Il percorso ciclabile regionale “Ticino” [PCIR 01] ha avvio a nord, al confine con la Svizzera, in località Lavena Ponte Tresa (VA) e finisce a Pavia.

r.name: Ciclovia Pedemontana Alpina - Laghi di Lombardia
P02 - Cossogno - Pizzo Pernice
r.description: From Cossogno amidst chestnut on the ancient cobbled mule track to Alpe Rugno, then for the meadows of high pastures and finally the long panoramic ridge that culminates at Pizzo Pernice

r.name: P01 - Madonna di campagna - Monterosso - Cavandone
r.description: An easy walk on Monterosso, mountain overlooking Verbania. Roads and firebreaks facilitate the journey. A picnic area with views of Stresa and the Borromeo Gulf is a pleasant stopover to climb term

r.name: A00 - Strada Romana (terza sezione)
r.description: A long walk in the woods and the hills between Lake Maggiore and Mergozzo on the historic Roman road that led to the Ossola and the Simplon Pass

r.name: P00 - Madonna di Campagna - Santino - Rovegro- Cossogno- Cicogna - Pogallo
P00c - Nord Monterosso - Bieno - Oratorio Santino
r.description: Useful way to link the path P00 between the north Monterosso area and the Oratory of Santino, Bieno through, without to loose elevation down to Santino

r.name: P01b - Suna - Chiesetta Pellegrino
r.description: Very steep path that from Suna climbs to the Chiesetta del Pellegrino, historically followed by a Christian worship procession very popular among the Suna population

r.name: P01c - Sentiero della Bergamina
r.description: Mountain side path on the Monterosso that from Suna climbs to Cavandone among chestnut woods and with views over the Borromeo Gulf

r.name: P01d - Cavandone - bivio Via al Monterosso
r.description: An easy walk almost flat in the woods of Monterosso. Pay attention to mountain bikes

r.name: XP0B - Filo di Nolezzo
r.description: The Filo di Nolezzo is worthy of its name: a perfect ridge line, aerial from beginning to end, extremely panoramic and never really difficult, even if there are some very exposed and treacherous sections, especially in autumn for the leaves

r.name: R16 Sacro Monte SS.Trinità di Ghiffa - Pollino
r.description: Route between the Sacro Monte SS. Trinità, World Heritage of Humanity, and Pollino: inside broad-leaved woods, Special Nature Reserve, at times steep pass by the Sabbia Rossa Chapel and the Streghe little lake. Views on Lake Maggiore.

r.name: R24 Gonte - Casola - Manegra
r.description: From Gonte to Manegra via Alpe Casola. Start between inhabited hamlets, then trail with some steep parts, from A.Casola forest road. From Cappella S.Maria to A.Casola poor maintenance; difficult passage in small valley ~780 m under A.Casola.

r.name: R22 Travallino di Oggebbio - Luera
r.description: From Travallino, hamlet of Oggebbio, P.zza chiesa Sant'Antonio, through hamlets Piazza, Dumera, Casere Comino, up to Luera, crossroads with R10, R12, R14, R18.

r.name: R18 Camogno - Luera
r.description: The route starts from Camogno, at the junction with the provincial road where passes the Via delle Genti (R30) and ends at Luera, crossroads with the routes R10, R12, R14, R22.

r.name: R02 Verbania Intra bivio R30 Via Selasca - Arizzano - Albagnano - Premeno - Pizzo d'Omo
r.description: From Verbania Intra crossroads R30 Via Selasca through Pastura, Antoliva, Cresseglio, Cissano, Arizzano, Albagnano, then the holiday resorts Premeno and Pian di Sole, to climb to Pizzo d'Omo (m 1056) and finish at the crossroads of the path R02,R02A,R10.

r.name: R04 Verbania Intra - Zoverallo - San Martino - Bèe - Monte Cimolo - Pian Nava
r.description: From Verbania Intra P.za Ranzoni (crossroads R30) through Zoverallo, San Martino, Bèe, to climb to Monte Cimolo (m 950) and walk down at Pian Nava (crossroads R06, R08).

r.name: R00 Verbania Intra P.le Flaim - Trobaso - Cambiasca - Caprezzo - Intragna - Aurano
r.description: From Verbania Intra P.le Flaim through Trobaso,Cambiasca,Caprezzo,Intragna to Aurano, crossroad with R8,R14,R15. Long path that enters the uncontaminated Valle Intrasca of the San Giovanni torrent, adjoining the Val Grande National Park.

r.name: R01 Verbania Trobaso - Unchio - Motto di Unchio - Pian di Les - Cossogno
r.description: From Verbania Trobaso, Via al Cotonificio, you reach the cycle road on the left side of the San Bernardino river, go up to Unchio and the Oratory of Motto di Unchio, then through a peat bog and Pian di Les, you reach Cossogno (crossroads P00).

r.name: R02a Premeno - Pizzo d'Omo (bivio R10)
r.description: From Premeno,crossroad R02,in direction of Le Australie,go up the provincial road to Pollino,after about 300 m deviate into V.Manegra. A path on the left leads to Sasso Mezzano with a wonderful view of Lago Maggiore,then to the crossroad with R10.

r.name: R10 Sacro Monte S.S.Trinità di Ghiffa - Pollino - Piancavallo - Colle - Passo Folungo
r.description: Long route from the Sacro Monte SS.Trinità di Ghiffa,Sanctuary and Unesco Heritage,to Passo Folungo,between Valle Intrasca and Cannobina,through Caronio,Pollino,Luera,Manegra, Piancavallo,crossroads for Cima Morissolo,Colle,Pian d'Arla and Pian Puzz.

r.name: R14 Aurano - Luera
r.description: The route starts from Aurano, crosses some little valleys to reach the Alpe Erbia and then, with a flat path, reaches Luera, crossroads the R10, R12, R18, R22 routes.

r.name: R03 Cambiasca - Pian Cavallone - Pizzo Marona - Monte Zeda
r.description: Route of great landscape interest that goes from Cambiasca to Monte Zeda passing from the peak of Pizzo Marona; it crosses Miazzina,Alpe Pala,Cappella Fina,Pian Cavallone,Colle Forcola,Passo del Diavolo,Pizzo Marona. Exposed stretch with chains.

r.name: R07 Intragna - Cappella del Pian Cavallone
r.description: In very open environment between Intragna and the Rifugio Pian Cavallone CAI Verbano,through Cambiesso and Sunfaì along the route of the Valle Intrasca Marathon.Continuing on R03,near the ruined of ex-hotel,there is the winter bivouac always open.

r.name: R05 Caprezzo - Pian Cavallone bivio R07
r.description: The route connects Caprezzo to the R07 crossroads just below the CAI refuge at Pian Cavallone. From Caprezzo, climbing to the Mon Rous and Ad Vel pastures, you reach Cappella Porta, then, in a beech and fir wood, climb to the CAI Verbano refuge.

r.name: R03a Cappella Fina bivio R03 - Bivio R05 tra Cappella Porta e Cornala
r.description: Connection route between Cappella Fina (crossroads R03) and crossroads with R05 Cappella Porta-Cornala. Useful for the R03-R05 ring route through Pian Cavallone. Some large part of the route on a wide dirt road and part on path. Some small stream fords.

r.name: R30 'Via delle Genti': tratto Cannero - Oggebbio - Sacro Monte SS.Trinità di Ghiffa - Verbania Intra
r.description: Historic "Via delle Genti". Route from Cannero to Intra through the numerous hamlets of Oggebbio. Superb panoramic view of Lake Maggiore in a succession of frescoed oratories and chapels. Sacro Monte SS.Trinità di Ghiffa, Sanctuary and Unesco Heritage.

r.name: R08 Aurano - Esio - Premeno
r.description: The route starts from Aurano, descends to the stream of Val Luisina crossing the provincial road several times; it climbs to Esio with a path immersed in broadleaf forest and first on the road and then on a comfortable mule track comes to Premeno.

r.name: R12 - Esio - Luera
r.description: The route, in the woods on the hillside, starts from the square of Esio on a paved road, then continues on a gravel road and on a path, then on a cart track it reach Luera.

r.name: P02b - Miazzina - Alpe Runchio
r.description: Short connection between the R03 and P02 paths and the quickest access to the large summer pasture of Runchio (Rugno)

r.name: P02c - Memoriale Alpini - Alpe della Chiesa
r.description: Relaxing almost flat walk between the R03 and P02 paths, a very visible and easily walkable route

r.name: P02d - Cappella Fina - bivio P02 sotto Monte Todun
r.description: Relaxing almost flat walk between the R03 and P02 paths, a very visible and easily walkable route

r.name: In Bici tra i Fiori
r.description: iIl percorso raggiunge il canneto della Riserva Naturale Speciale di Fondotoce e la stazione ferroviaria di Verbania Pallanza attraversando le zone di produzione dei Fiori Tipici del Lago Maggiore. Consigliato tra aprile e maggio.

r.name: Anello di mezzo di San Salvatore
VH2 - Massino Visconti - Alpe Canà
r.description: From Massino Visconti through the old part of the village before ascending via a historic mule track, after the Monte locality, it continues across level ground, traverses the hillside to the ridge, and ends at a small saddle at the V00 junction.

r.name: VF3 - Fosseno - Alpe del Bosco
r.description: Initially, the route crosses meadows, then enters a dense chestnut forest, ascending the hillside along a worn but passable surface.

r.name: VM2 - Baveno - Alpe Vedabia
r.description: Initially you travel along roads and dirt roads till Romanico then you enter broad-leaved woods up to the destination with a route mainly on paths and forest tracks. A ford at the Selva Spessa stream can pose problems in case of rain

r.name: VL7a - Nocco - Alpe Martin
r.description: The route begins in Nocco, at the junction with the VL7 trail. Leaving the village, a track crosses the Rio Erno and one of its tributaries via two convenient bridges; after the second bridge, the road becames a path sometime slippery until the end.

r.name: VL4 - Comnago - Calogna
r.description: An easy, short route that climbs toward Comnago along an old mule track, cutting across the airpin bends; it then continues with a brief ascent partly on asphalt and partly on a path until it reaches the junction with the VL3 trail

r.name: VR4 - Armeno - Gignese
r.description: The route consists mainly of forest dirt tracks and paved roads; a section of the trail shortly after Cascina Gridella is impassable due to vegetation.

r.name: Sentiero delle Meraviglie nascoste
r.operator: Parco lombardo della valle del Ticino

r.name: Sentiero del Monte Pelada
r.operator: Parco lombardo della valle del Ticino

r.name: Anello Monte San Giacomo
r.operator: Parco lombardo della valle del Ticino

r.name: R01b Bivio R01 sotto Motto di Unchio - Bivio R01 a Pian di Les (Giro del Motto di Unchio)
r.description: An easy path from Verbania Unchio, junction R01 under the mule-track of the ascent to Motto di Unchio, leads to Pian di Les where it meets again R01. Halfway through the recently restored Chapel of the Madonna of Fever.

r.name: R06 Trobaso - Pian Nava
r.description: Verbania Trobaso, Possaccio, terracing west of Bureglio-Vignone, Cà di Müii, crossing of ancient paths, Sentiero delle Coppelle and rock engravings. From Vignone-swimming pool steep path up to Roncaccio (south M.Cimolo), then wide path up to Pian Nava.

r.name: European Long distance path E1 - part Italy - Lombardy
Percorso della Memoria
r.description: Eccidio di San Marcello 28-03-1945

r.name: R09 Intragna - Onunchio - Colle della Forcola
r.description: Intragna and pasture Corpetto, Doaglia, Usciago, Casaiuva, Onunchio, Colle della Forcola. A path in the San Giovanni Valley on practicable and signposted paths up to Onunchio, then less obvious signs with some demanding passages.

r.name: R05b Caprezzo - Alpe Mon Rous (Ôr dal Ruś)
r.description: The route connects Caprezzo at the crossroads of R05 at the Alpe Mon Rous, better known as "Ôr dal Ruś". The part of route around "il Cev" is on asphalted road.

r.name: R15 Aurano - Calpera - il Colle
r.description: The route connects Aurano passing through its numerous ancient Courts and Pastures (Giovanoli, Segletta connected by a short detour, Caramelli, Laveggio, Calpera) to il Colle, a crossroads of numerous other routes coming from all directions.

r.name: R07a Cambiesso - Cappella Porta
r.description: From Cambiesso to Cappella Porta passing by Corte Steppio, still loaded with animals in summer and with some well-kept huts, and then by the old pastures of Pechi-Campale, Gajin and Fai. Numerous fords. Some passages exposed but equipped

r.name: R05a Caprezzo - Tremesino - Alpe a Pönt - Bivio R05 sotto Cappella Porta
r.description: The route starts from the crossroads of R00 in Via dei Ronchi in Caprezzo, climbs to the pasture of Tremesino, reaches the carriage road to the Alpe a Pönt and arrives at the crossroads of R05 just before Cappella Porta.

r.name: P01e - Cavandone - Cascina Monterosso
r.description: Interesting summer route on the North side of Monterosso, two coalmen' pitches and the ruins of the Monterosso Farmhouse are visible, the only located on this side of the mountain. Not recommended with rain or frost.

r.name: 617 Sentiero della Lungo un filo di seta
614E Sentiero delle Erbe e degli Alberi
613D Sentiero dell'Oasi della Bruschera - Variante D
Collegamento Sentiero San Giacomo - Sentiero Monte Pelada

r.description: Wonderful path up to the peak. Some parts are very steep and path is not always easy to find. GPS track might help.
